correctness.rationale: Headline (a): S_B analytic proof verified line-by-line. z=-I has det 1, trace -2 != 2 (q odd), so z not in U_q; u(a) has det 1, trace 2, !=1 iff a!=0; for prime q>=7 residues +-1,+-2,+-3 are six distinct nonzeros, so |S_B|=7 and S_B={z} U A U A^{-1} in C_q. All generators upper-triangular => <S_B> contained in proper Borel B (|B|=q(q-1)<q(q^2-1)). <u(1)> has order q, z not in it (trace), z central order 2, so H=<u(1)>x<z> has order 2q, S_B subset H and u(1),z in S_B generate H, so <S_B>=H exactly. Hence Cayley component size 2q, (q^2-1)/2 components; double cover disconnected. 4q-vertex double-cover components follow from disconnected base plus non-bipartite base components (triangle 1-u(1)-u(3)-1 via u(1)*u(2)=u(3)); BFS confirms 14/336 and 28/672 at q=7. Headline (b): S_R membership verified by recomputation (each r_i det 1, tr 2, !=1; inverses as listed in set; z trace 5 distinct; 3 inverse pairs + z, |S|=7, symmetric, so in C_7). Generation verified by re-running inputs/artifacts/verify.py => VERIFY_OK (Cayley 336/336, double 672/672, symmetric, 7-regular, non-bipartite Cayley). Ramanujan bound: 4.89<2*sqrt(6) via 4898^2=23990404<24000000 exactly. Lower leg -lam_min<=4.89: independently re-ran exact symmetric Bareiss on M_lo=100A+489I (rebuilt from scratch) => PD True, all 336 pivots >0, min pivot 489 (~20s). Upper leg lam2(G)<=4.89: ran inputs/artifacts/exact_rayleigh.py => EXACT_OK; recomputed p=55177273021248, qq=11289966448320, p^2<24*qq^2 and p*100<=489*qq exactly in Python ints, w sum 0 nonzero, so Courant-Fischer (Cayley connected, top eigenvector 1) gives lam2(G)<=p/qq=4.88728...<2*sqrt(6). Hence lam2(X)=max(lam2(G),-lam_min)<=4.89<2*sqrt(6); X connected 7-regular bipartite on 672 vertices, Ramanujan. Committed M_up log (PD True, min pivot 16451836) is consistent but not needed given Rayleigh. Headline (c) non-normality: recomputed h=(0,1,6,0), s=(4,2,6,5), hsh^-1=(5,1,5,4) not in S_R, correct; block-trace vs spectrum remark is standard representation theory. Sweep frequency and (R/N)-pattern claims are explicitly evidence-only in DRAFT limitations, not part of exact headline. Distinguished proof (a, b exact certs) from experimental envelope (two eigensolvers, traces, residuals).

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route: genuinely arose from target investigation (Borel-containment connectedness check yielding S_B; spectral sweep of admitted class C_7 yielding S_R), using the same group SL(2,7), same class C_q/C_7, same threshold 2*sqrt(6) — not a convenient replacement task. Substantive comparison: MSS I (arXiv:1304.4132) proves existential infinite bipartite Ramanujan families of all degrees via 2-lifts (non-Cayley); MSS IV (arXiv:1505.08010) extends to all sizes via random matchings; HPS (arXiv:1506.02335) proves every graph has an r-covering with new eigenvalues bounded by universal-cover radius — all existential covering theory with no fixed central-unipotent Cayley class, no SL(2,7) generating set, no uniform (im)possibility over C_7. LPS/Morgenstern (per Lubotzky survey arXiv:1105.2389) give Cayley Ramanujan only at degrees p+1/q+1, missing d=7 (6 not a prime power); single-graph character evaluation documented there is routine and does not imply any C_7-wide statement. No live source records S_B, S_R, their spectra, or any universal statement over C_q/C_7; internal priors (SCOPE050/038 Hurwitz/PSL(2,q) generation, SCOPE088 A5 normal Cayley, SCOPE031 circulants, dicyclic/Petersen failures) differ in group, degree, bipartiteness, and barrier-vs-witness direction. The specific refutation witnesses and exact integer certificates are not in the cited priors and are not mechanical corollaries of one character-sum evaluation.

value.rationale: Ordinary full value standard with no presumption (EMERGENT_FINDING). Strongest self-contained headline: exact two-sided refutation inside the pre-motivated natural class C_q at the pre-motivated threshold 2*sqrt(6) — (i) infinite analytic disconnected family S_B (order-2q Borel subgroup, falsifies connectedness conjunct at every q>=7), (ii) exact Ramanujan member S_R in C_7 with integer-arithmetic certificate lam2(X)<=4.89<2*sqrt(6) (falsifies strict-inequality conjunct), (iii) pinned diagnosis (non-normal S, class-function sign cannot upper-bound lam2). Object and invariant motivated before computation (smallest Cayley-missing degree d=7, canonical central-unipotent lift form, Ramanujan bound itself); value not known or mechanically implied; future researcher querying (SL(2,q), central-unipotent 7-lift, Ramanujan) reasonably needs this precise mixed-class fact. Actionable guidance reversal (do not exclude C_q wholesale; any future barrier needs generating hypothesis plus non-class-function methods) plus reusable exact Bareiss/Rayleigh Cayley-spectrum audit template. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain (margin 0.0117 crosses the threshold), or unexplained enumeration: one exact witness with proof. Incomplete census honestly disclosed (single-witness cert; sweep frequency estimate; q=11 probe evidence-only) and does not erase the exact headline; no general criterion or completed census demanded.
